name: Ushinawareta Rakuen
source:
Nishijima Kousaku, an university student, attracted by a high payment, takes part in the scientific expedition on a southern island, organized by Hazama, a professor from his university. However, a storm breaks out and the ship suffers a shipwreck. Members of the expedition are washed ashore and start exploring the island in search of professor Hazama.
But soon enough they notice that something strange is happening around them...

[Edited from [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/review-of-ushinawareta-rakuen-silkys.html]vndbreview[/url]]
